title: Speak to Cassius

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Ah! I’m so pleased to see you. I have another question…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah! I’m so pleased to see you. I have another question…

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Would you care to, ahem, peruse a hydrophobic carpet catalogue with me? I could bring it round to your apartment tonight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would you care to, ahem, peruse a hydrophobic carpet catalogue with me? I could bring it round to your apartment tonight.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: It's... no, never mind. Is there something I can do for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's... no, never mind. Is there something I can do for you?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Hang out… as in...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hang out… as in...?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Oh! Haha, yes. That makes a lot more sense. Yes. I am asking if you would like to "hang out".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh! Haha, yes. That makes a lot more sense. Yes. I am asking if you would like to "hang out".

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Is it about water? Because I have to be honest, the concept of drainspin is still troubling me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it about water? Because I have to be honest, the concept of drainspin is still troubling me...

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Oh. I don’t know. Do I?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh. I don’t know. Do I?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: So different to Luna… I had no idea. Do you know of someone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So different to Luna… I had no idea. Do you know of someone?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: I like to repay my debts where I can. You have someone in mind, I presume?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like to repay my debts where I can. You have someone in mind, I presume?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: My father always said favors are for the weak. But I suppose he isn't here. You have a candidate in mind?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My father always said favors are for the weak. But I suppose he isn't here. You have a candidate in mind?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Then I shall have my people contact him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I shall have my people contact him.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: It is good to help those who are reliant on Lims, isn’t it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is good to help those who are reliant on Lims, isn’t it?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: As would I! So, ah... did you want to ask me something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As would I! So, ah... did you want to ask me something?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: I quite understand. Did you wish to ask me something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I quite understand. Did you wish to ask me something?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: What a fascinating person you are. I will look forward to "hanging out" together...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What a fascinating person you are. I will look forward to "hanging out" together...

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: What an interesting person you are. Now, if you'll excuse me, hotel business calls.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What an interesting person you are. Now, if you'll excuse me, hotel business calls.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Date… as in...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Date… as in...?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: I will certainly do so. Connections are everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will certainly do so. Connections are everything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So do I, actually.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So do I, actually.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go ahead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go ahead.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you asking if I want to hang out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you asking if I want to hang out?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you asking if I want to hang out?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you asking if I want to hang out?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Spend time in each other’s company.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Spend time in each other’s company.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Spend time in each other’s company.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Spend time in each other’s company.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It’s about your hotel. In the Spire. Do you need a hygiene inspector?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It’s about your hotel. In the Spire. Do you need a hygiene inspector?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It’s about your hotel. In the Spire. Do you need a hygiene inspector?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It’s about your hotel. In the Spire. Do you need a hygiene inspector?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Probably not, but you’d be doing me a favor if you hired one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Probably not, but you’d be doing me a favor if you hired one.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Probably not, but you’d be doing me a favor if you hired one.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Probably not, but you’d be doing me a favor if you hired one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. All the best hotels have one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. All the best hotels have one.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. All the best hotels have one.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. All the best hotels have one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, I know a guy. Cecil Grimes. He’s… very diligent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I know a guy. Cecil Grimes. He’s… very diligent.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes, I know a guy. Cecil Grimes. He’s… very diligent.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes, I know a guy. Cecil Grimes. He’s… very diligent.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’m sure he’ll be pleased.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m sure he’ll be pleased.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’d say so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’d say so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Only if it benefits us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Only if it benefits us.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure. I'd like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. I'd like that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm kinda busy right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm kinda busy right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell them to mention my name.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell them to mention my name.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Tell them to mention my name.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Tell them to mention my name.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you asking me for a date?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you asking me for a date?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you asking me for a date?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you asking me for a date?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hanging out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hanging out.
